title: Build the scaled maze grid
description: You define free cells, walls, and their world-unit scale.

steps.description: You define Maze with a grid and scale. The comments assign zero to free cells, one to walls, and meters per cell to scale.
You construct a seven-row grid with ten columns. The returned maze uses scale=1.0, or one meter per cell.

steps.question: Which grid entries become True in free_mask?
steps.answer: Entries equal to zero become True. Wall entries become False.

steps.description: You construct the maze and count True entries in free_mask. The recorded output reports a 7 by 10 grid with 53 free cells.
